data.current_description: Verify the OTP and authenticate the user.
data.description_suggestion: Verify the OTP code and authenticate the user. Validates the OTP against the stored value. For new users, creates a subscriber account in Sippy (generates DID and SIP credentials) and MC database with profile_status set to 'blocked', then generates a JWT access token. For existing users, returns the current profile information. Returns the user profile with access_token required for all subsequent authenticated requests via Authorization: Bearer header.

data.current_description: Update user profile with NID information and images.
data.summary_suggestion: Submit NID verification and update profile information
data.description_suggestion: Submit NID information and images to verify the user's identity and unblock the account. Accepts multipart/form-data with NID number, date of birth, full name, and NID images (front, back, and selfie). Supported formats: JPEG, PNG (max 5MB per image). Upon successful verification, updates profile_status from 'blocked' to 'unblocked' and enables calling functionality by updating DID status in Sippy server. Partial profile updates are supported for non-verification fields.
